source_evidence: Day328~12:30 exact player 'Let’s go to desen' authorizes ordinary conclusion of Harthvale audience, departure together and visit to established Sgt Rill Desen at Western District Watch annex to report today's findings, consistent with prior explicit companion plan. V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar leave without obstruction; no new V speech or handshake invented, no observed following. Desen receives full factual briefing: Harthvale personally admitted approving association payments through broker to Tavosk and knowing some imports landed without assessed duties; association member households Dunmere/Rellwick/Branthor, Orren Vaskel broker, Berric Sornell accountant, Tavren Holtwick escort captain, disclosed seven other escorts/four participating hands, three boats/two leased storehouses/rented office, lawful freight and undeclared luxury textiles, Halvessa's conditional250gp exclusivity offer, the keeper openly showing matching D3206gp/D3238gp warning payments and Lot27 sale36gp, the nonbinding250gp prospective capital proposal and oral one-of-four votes/25% future distributable profit terms, and Sornell's unresolved promised exit settlement. Companions voluntarily confirm their firsthand observations; no claim of exhaustive verification, other prohibited goods, murder link, actual partnership or member assent. V shows signed preliminary Harthvale memorandum without surrender; retains original, no copying permission assumed for this paper. Desen explains that since yesterday's report he has actually consulted a customs examiner willing to act on the firsthand cargo and payment evidence; they are coordinating lawful inspection and preservation of records. This is newly played routine professional coordination consistent with prior stated intention and fixed honest examiner role in prep/dm-only/dm-ferry-setup.md @72d5bde0ab9d84d89fdc63f20cf9c7bfb63b1516; no warrant, seizure, deployment or arrest yet, no guaranteed judicial approval or recovery. Desen says today's direct admission provides a concrete basis for pursuing Harthvale himself and he will act through competent authorities, not require V to repeat undercover inquiries. On Sornell, he wants a voluntary firsthand interview before records can be lost if practicable; he can approach the accountant discreetly himself and arrange a safe place to speak, without promising immunity, payment of settlement or witness cooperation. He asks whether V would prefer to approach Sornell first through the already established relationship, or leave that contact to the Watch; V need not undertake either to preserve progress. No contact with Sornell yet, no new threat or clock beyond elapsed routine city travel and briefing. No dice, expenditure, resource use or new document transfer. Await V decision.
